text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5. Two letters of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 6. Health certificate Required during application.Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months) 7. HSK Certificate Level 4 or above
